quests.title: Short Delivery, Fennell Street
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The Fennell Street order has been two cartons light every week since Thursdays and the invoice says otherwise every time. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Fennell Street
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $65 owing to Fennell Street and it is not going to walk in here itself. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $65, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Fennell Street Run
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I do the Fennell Street run at first light and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Prince Alfred Square
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Fennell Street
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I have got a esky of warm cans in the back of the van and the Fennell Street shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Fennell Street
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Three of the Fennell Street regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $91 down on those days. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$91, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Fennell Street
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Everything Fennell Street sells comes off a floor at Robin Thomas, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Padstow
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Padstow on the week of the show and one of them has a note from his mother. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Padstow
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. We found a twelfth, which means the Padstow club now owes the association $62 it had budgeted on not owing. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $62 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Padstow Canteen
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The canteen at Padstow does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at the second express. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Padstow
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Somebody walked off with the float from the Padstow canteen at about the second express during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$75, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Padstow
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The sprinkler line under the Padstow outfield has been leaking since the week of the show and the wet patch has started to move. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Padstow
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Revesby, and Padstow has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Seven Hills
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Seven Hills since the week of the show and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. They have agreed to a clean-up at Seven Hills, which is wonderful, except the grant is $53 short and closes on the week of the show. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $53, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. We had 34 sandbags in the Seven Hills shed on the week of the show and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. People keep driving the low crossing at Seven Hills at first light with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The water came through my place at Seven Hills on the week of the show and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Whatever is happening to Seven Hills starts upstream at Toongabbie, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
